title: Atropos neutral symbol index
description: The seam between Atropos and any graph engine. An engine (e.g. Lachesis) exports the symbols and callsites of a codebase into this engine-agnostic shape; the Atropos binder resolves models against it and applies each access_path to an exact node handle. Atropos never imports the engine; the engine exports into this. Node ids are opaque handles owned by the exporter.

source.description: Human reference (e.g. the fixture path). Not used for binding.

declarations.description: Optional: resolved declarations, for name-level checks. Binding attaches at callsites.

name.description: Callee symbol name as the engine resolves it.

module.description: Owning module/package, or null for a builtin. A model's package constrains only when both sides carry a value.

receiver_type.description: Owning type for a method call; null for a free function. Matches a model's type hint.

call_value_id.description: Node for the call result (ReturnValue attaches here).

receiver_value_id.description: Node for the receiver (Receiver attaches here).

receiver_provenance.description: Neutral provenance such as cursor-factory; not a static type claim.

arg_value_ids.description: Argument value nodes in order; Argument[n] attaches to element n.
